name: Qoder

form_factor.comment: Qoder provides an agentic IDE, a JetBrains plugin, Qoder CLI, TypeScript and Python Agent SDKs, managed Cloud Agents, a desktop agentic-coding app, and mobile agent control. QoderWork is a broader work assistant and is not treated as a separate coding harness here. Per-form-factor links: IDE: https://docs.qoder.com/desktop/overview; Extension: https://docs.qoder.com/plugins/introduction; CLI: https://docs.qoder.com/cli/installation; SDK: https://docs.qoder.com/cli/sdk/overview; Web: https://docs.qoder.com/cloud-agents/overview; Desktop App: https://qoder.com/; Mobile: https://docs.qoder.com/mobile/app/download.

released_in.comment: Qoder announced its standalone terminal coding agent on October 15, 2025.

latest_major_update.comment: Qoder 0.2.5 shipped September 12, 2026 with remembered file-opening behavior, more reliable realtime voice, lower file-review CPU use, browser-login reuse, streaming-scroll fixes, and Chinese Computer Use fixes. Versions 0.2.2-0.2.3 added proxy configuration, Goal turn limits, model-choice persistence, and safer Computer Use actions.

rules.comment: Hierarchical user, project, and local AGENTS.md instructions plus .qoder/rules files and optional Auto-Memory.

skills.comment: Agent Skills use SKILL.md packages at user and project scope, can be invoked manually or selected by the model, and can be bundled by plugins.

hooks.comment: Hook system covers prompt, tool, permission, session, subagent, compaction, and notification events with command, prompt, and agent handlers.

mcp_servers.comment: MCP servers integrate external tools and data, use the normal permission system, and can be managed by CLI subcommands or supplied with --mcp-config.

custom_commands.comment: User-defined prompt commands work in the TUI and headless mode and are loaded from scoped command configuration.

goal_command.comment: Built-in /goal support tracks and executes longer-running objectives; current releases allow up to 100 interactions by default.

subagents.comment: Built-in and custom subagents support independent tool, model, permission, runtime, skill, hook, memory, background, and worktree-isolation configuration.

monitor.comment: Qoder has background subagents, scheduled tasks, loops, goals, and session status, but reviewed docs do not establish a general arbitrary command, log, or WebSocket monitor surface.

model_selection.comment: Launch-time --model selection, in-session model controls, reasoning effort, list-models, named Qoder tiers, and BYOK model identifiers.

approval_mode.comment: Default, plan, auto, bypass, accept-edits, and do-not-ask permission modes plus allow, ask, and deny rules and per-tool controls.

sandbox_mode.comment: The --sandbox switch enables an environment-selected sandbox backend, configured by QODER_SANDBOX or tools.sandbox.

resume.comment: Use --resume or -r with a session identifier, or omit the identifier to open the selector.

continue.comment: Use --continue or -c to resume the most recent session.

non_interactive.comment: Passing a prompt or -p/--print runs headlessly, prints the result, and exits for scripts and CI workflows.

output_format.comment: The CLI supports selectable output and input formats plus a maximum output-token limit for scripted execution.

statusline.comment: A built-in statusline-setup agent helps configure the interactive status bar.

telemetry.comment: Current public settings documentation reviewed did not establish an end-user OpenTelemetry export or equivalent telemetry pipeline.

custom_model_provider.comment: Personal-plan BYOK supports custom Base URLs for OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible model services, in addition to Qoder's hosted model tiers.

notes: Qoder is Alibaba's agentic coding platform. This row combines its coding-focused IDE, JetBrains plugin, CLI, SDK, cloud, desktop, and mobile control surfaces. QoderWork is broader desktop work automation, so it is noted but not added as another coding-agent row.

pricing.value: Free; Pro $20/mo; Pro+ $60/mo; Ultra $200/mo; Teams and Enterprise plans; BYOK; 14-day Pro trial for eligible new client users
pricing.comment: Qoder lists Free, Pro, Pro+, Ultra, Teams, and Enterprise plans, with monthly credits for hosted models and BYOK on the Free plan.

hosted_agent.comment: Qoder Cloud Agents run managed sessions through APIs with configurable agents and environments, while --remote creates cloud sessions from the CLI.

transcripts.comment: Sessions persist by default and can be listed, resumed, continued, deleted, or disabled for a one-shot run with --no-session-persistence.

keyboard_shortcuts.comment: The TUI documents keyboard interactions, but customizable keybindings were not established in the reviewed official sources.

theme_customization.comment: The CLI includes multiple built-in themes, automatic light and dark switching, and user-defined color schemes through ui.customThemes.

auto_save.comment: Session persistence is documented, but a distinct automatic file-save control was not established.

debugging_output.comment: The -d/--debug flag enables debug log output.

context_window.comment: The --context-window flag overrides the context-window size for supported models, and the runtime compacts long sessions.

code_formatting.comment: The agent can run project formatters through Bash, but a first-party automatic formatting control was not established.

git_integration.comment: Built-in worktree isolation, commit-message generation and commits, rollback, Git-aware session workflows, and cloud task handoff.

performance_mode.comment: Qoder exposes lite, efficient, performance, and other model tiers plus reasoning controls, but not a separate local runtime performance switch.

ui_customization.comment: The TUI can hide its banner and footer, show line numbers, compact tool output, adjust loading phrases, configure the status bar, and set accessibility behavior.
